selection.rule: in every prompt set: attribution rank <= max_rank, single-knockout P(answer) drop >= min_drop; label names the concept (keywords.json); best worst-case drop per concept

tier1.what: shipped prompts: the same measurement should reproduce near-exactly on any machine
tier1.marker_ok: rank <= rank_factor * key rank + rank_slack and drop >= drop_factor * key drop

tier2.what: fresh recall prompts written by your labeller

tier3.what: fresh blind labels for the marker neurons, from your own atlas and labeller
tier3.marker_ok: the recall-pole label contains one of the marker's keywords
